kill_criteria_template: trailing-13-week realised excess below 0; any matched hack or depeg in a held pool; capacity under $1M
note: Frozen before the full grid was evaluated. Two variants (all k7 h1.0 H1, bluechip k30 h0.5 H4) were run once on partial data (1,495 of ~5,000 pools, reward prices all imputed, no dollar-symbol filter) as a smoke test of the code; no variant, filter or parameter was changed after seeing returns except the dollar-token filter, which removes non-dollar tokens DefiLlama flags as stablecoins (a data-definition fix, decided from symbols, not returns).
selection: per universe (all, bluechip), the variant with the highest in-sample mean weekly excess over the savings rate actually paid, at $1M, N=5, buffer 2N; tested once on decisions from the split on
